text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Not too shabby, right? I made it onto the scoreboard after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yup, this feels about right. Nice and safe.
choice_data_list: You should be prouder of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yup, this feels about right. Nice and safe.
choice_data_list: You should be prouder of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to be proud of, though. I didn't win or anything.
choice_data_list: It's proof that you have potential. You'll definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uh… I don't know how you can say things like "definitely" with such conviction.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess it's good for my trainer to have confidence in me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I won't go as far as to say I'll definitely win, but I can aim for it at least.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't go all drill sergeant on me! That won't whip me into shape.
choice_data_list: So… you're okay with where you are then?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Of… course not. You know that.
choice_data_list: Then let's do even better next time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh… You always try to make me say I'll do better.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …But if I win, that means you'll stop, right?
